notes: Welcome, everyone, to this year's dealer conference. Today's question is a simple one: gold has hit a record, so what do we sell now? Over the past two years the gold price is what you have felt most in your stores. We will first look at what has happened outside, to the price, to customers and to the trade, then at what we do together next year, and finish with five things we would like to decide with you. Every figure today comes from official statistics, industry associations or listed companies' filings, and each page names its source. Our own operating figures stay off the screen. We will go through them region by region after the session.
